# Booked

> Booked is an iPhone app for actors to memorize lines, rehearse scenes and record self-tapes without a reader. It is a self-tape reader that runs your sides with you, comes in on your cue, feeds you the next words when you say "line", and records the take. It also keeps an audition tracker with stats and a yearly Wrapped. Made by a working actor. On the App Store for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6818271531. Android after.

## What it does
- Import sides as a PDF, or share the PDF straight from the email it arrived in. Booked works out who says what, including handwritten start and end marks.
- Rehearse without a scene partner: the audition reader plays the other characters in a natural voice, waits while you speak, and comes in on your last word. Speech is recognised on the phone; no audio leaves it during a rehearsal.
- Memorize lines: run the scene as often as you like, and say "line" when you blank so the reader feeds you the next few words.
- Record self-tapes without a reader: the same scene with the camera on. Takes save to the Photos library and never leave the phone.
- Track: log auditions, see auditions per year, yes rate, who calls you in most, and a Wrapped at the end of the year. Signing in (Apple or Google) is needed only for the log.

## Privacy
Scripts, rehearsals and self-tapes are not used to train AI, by Booked or by the services behind the reader (OpenAI for parsing the script, ElevenLabs for the voices). Self-tapes are never uploaded. Analytics are product interaction only, never script text. Accounts can be deleted from inside the app.

## Pricing
Free to download. The audition tracker and the demo scene are free. A reader for your own sides comes with an auto-renewing monthly subscription through the App Store, US$14.99 a month (local prices vary), priced under hiring a reader.

## FAQ
- How do I self-tape without a reader? Use a self-tape reader app. Booked reads the other characters in a natural voice, waits while you speak, and comes in on your last word, so you can record the take alone.
- Is there an app to help me memorize lines? Yes. Booked runs the scene with you as many times as you like, with the reader playing the other characters, so you memorize your lines on their cues. When you blank, call "line" and it feeds you the next few words.
- How can I learn lines faster? Run the scene out loud with a reader as many times as it takes. When you blank, call "line" and Booked feeds you the next few words.
- Can I rehearse a scene without a scene partner? Yes. Booked's reader plays every other character, waits for you, and picks up on your last word, as often as you need.
- What do I need? An iPhone and the PDF of your sides.
- How do I get sides from my email into Booked? Open the email, tap the PDF, tap Share, pick Booked. The first time, Booked is under More: tap More, then Edit, then the + beside Booked, then the checkmark.
- Does it work with sides as they come? Yes, PDFs from casting or an agent, including sharp scans with start and end marks. Sides over 12 pages are not accepted.
- Is it free? Downloading, tracking auditions and the demo scene are free. A reader for your own sides comes with a monthly subscription.
- Does it learn from my scripts or tapes? No. Nothing is used to train AI, and takes never leave the phone.
- Android? After iPhone. There is an email waitlist on the home page (one note when it is on Google Play).
- Support: email aris@bookedactors.com, or Message Aris inside the app, which includes your Support ID.
